events.name: Bash
events.head: Check commits, stack ports, reports, walker code
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; git log --oneline -3 -- app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs; git status -sb | head -1; for p in 8970 8972 8974; do lsof -ti:$p >/dev/null && echo "$p up" || echo "$p down"; done; ls /tmp/walk/ 2>/dev/null | grep 242; sed -n 300,312p app/scripts/walk-ui.mjs
